key_insight: The paper introduces an exact SO(3)-equivariant CNN for spherical data on HEALPix, so the model learns physical symmetry by design instead of from data.
engineering_relevance: This reduces training-data demands and improves accuracy for scientific workflows on the sphere, especially when simulations are expensive and symmetry matters.
method: Builds a spherical gauge-equivariant mesh architecture for HEALPix.
Uses steerable filters, parallel transport, and spin-weighted features to enforce SO(3) equivariance.
Provides provably exact equivariance up to a chosen band-limit, with controllable invariance error.
evidence_signal: On benchmarks, the model achieves per-cent-level SO(3)-invariance error and strong results for dense gradient regression, CMB foreground removal/denoising, and cosmology lensing SBI.
watch_item: Performance depends on the chosen band-limit and spherical discretization, so implementation details may affect accuracy and computational cost.
paper_title: Learning without relearning physical symmetry: an SO(3)-equivariant convolutional network (CNN) on the sphere
